item.title: Sentinel: flow control internals
item.description: Sentinel is Alibaba’s library for flow control, concurrency limiting, circuit breaking, and system protection. An application protects a named resource by entering it through SphU.entry. A processor slot chain records statistics for that resource and applies the rules loaded at runtime.
